snippet.title: Midnight Souls | Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
You are a hero setting out to date a girl, whom you met online, traveling to the distant, unknown small town of Camomile Peaks. But not everything is as it seems, and soon enough, you'll find yourself in the middle of dark secrets and uncovered mysteries. Explore the mysteries of a small town, date the girl of your dreams, fight your enemies, and make socially acceptable friends in this dark humor-flavored RPG. And keep your cat, Charlie, out of trouble!

Wishlist now on Steam: https://s.team/a/3598180
